notes.title: Hot Fix for save files
notes.content:
There was a bug in the initial release of version 1.1 where it would delete all save files. This is the default action for any version update, but version 1.1 was specifically designed to be compatible with 1.0

It should no longer delete save files upon updating it.

I apologize for the inconvenience.


Please note
[list] 
[*]Only Version 1.0 save files are compatible with Version 1.1
[*]While the save files are compatible it is still recommended to start the level again. Some data did not exist in Version 1.0 and may result in strange behaviors (unnecessarily hard or slow etc)
[*]Level unlocks are not effected.
[/list]

Thank you!

tags.bug: It should no longer delete save files upon updating it.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update!
notes.content:
Few things to announce today!

First, version 1.1 is coming along very well. The latest DB044 version was planned to be pushed down to Version 1.1 this Thursday, but there has been some new features added in late which should be included in the 1.1 version. One of them is the new feature to get rid of negative perks (This should be released in the next few days to Dev Build)

Fortunately and unfortunately, the new features still need to be battle tested so I am delaying the push down to 1.1 to April 18. In the meantime, Dev Build should be receiving updates on regular basis per usual, so check those out if you are curious about the latest features.

Second: Please post bug reports in the bug report section. There are many reasons why I am enforcing this, but to keep things simple and efficient, please post in the appropriate sections.

Thanks!

notes.title: Version 0.8 and DB025 Released!
notes.content:
Here comes Version 0.8! I hope this time around, the push down to the main build goes smoothly without the need for a hotfix...but do expect some follow up patches if critical bugs occur in 0.8.

Also, per usual, please note that the save files will be deleted for compatibility reasons. Level unlock and achievements will still be there. This is inconvenient, but it also speeds up development during Early Access, so hope you understand that.

[h1]DB025 Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved: Added tavern naming to tutorial sequence.
[*]Improved: Level 8 goals and conditions revised.
[*]Fixed: Tavern name change announced even when the name was not changed.
[*]Fixed: Level 7 incorrect text display at the beginning of level.

[*]Improved: Level 7 goals made higher for more balanced gameplay.
[*]Improved: Bail out letter text added.

[*]Improved: Memory management which eliminates some random lag spikes.

notes.title: Please read!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Few announcements before the important news![/b][/h1]
So, I've been compiling a major pushdown of the current DB013 to Main Build. It will be called Version 0.6 and with it, comes all ten levels! (finally!)

It is very stable to play and with many new features, so I hope you all enjoy it.
The gameplay in general has been reworked as well.

ETA of Version 0.6 is this Thursday.

Please note that 32 bit support is now over and starting from Version 0.6 and future Dev Builds will no longer include 32 bit builds. 



[h1][b]Now the important announcement[/b][/h1]
With the latest Version 0.6 being pushed down to main build (ETA: This thursday) I think of it as a milestone, where the game is entering a Beta phase from the current Alpha phase.

I understand that being in Early Access Alpha, alpha/beta thing doesn't really work like it used to but I just wanted to let everyone know that I am prepping up the game in general and polishing it up for a full release. I do not have a set date, but I don't intend to add new drastic features or do a massive game overhaul.

Personally, I feel like that the game deserves another few years of development, make things better and better. But at the same time, I feel that I've been re-inventing the game over and over for the past year - improving the game in general but doing the same work over and over.

It is an uncomforting thought that at some point, it has to come to an end. And looking back to my initial Early Access goals, I am actually quite close to where I wanted to be when I first envisioned Tavern Tycoon.

Looking back at my long list of goals with pretty much everything ticked off "done" and only having few more lines (there is still work to be done :D) to go, I had to take a moment.

It is a strange feeling, acknowledging that I am almost there, but still seeing many things that I can do to improve, ultimately feeling "not quite there".

For Tavern Tycoon, I wanted to make a nurturing game that allowed players to experience a different sort of a video game. (Not that I am a huge FPS gamer :D) and I hope I delivered that.

Nevertheless, I think it is time to get the game ready for a full release and all effort from hereon will be focused on that. I will be making the game more presentable, more accessible and more enjoyable.

Thank you for the support!

notes.title: DB010 Released!
notes.content:
Finally, DB010 arrives! And regarding DB010, I have done many regrettable things in my life, but not as sorry as this one. When DB009 was released, my goal was to make DB010 with more balanced gameplay. I kept the whole month of September for this alone, as I understood that this is very important.

During my game balancing period, I kept feeling that the UI workflow was very disturbing. I know, I know. I made it that way, but after all this time, I had to re-evaluate. The minimalist style also didn't really look great.

So, DB010 became a huge patch (game balancing + UI overhaul + workflow overhaul) that I had to pull off in just one month and it did take me almost 2 months instead (It is October 24th now at the time of this writing).

Nevertheless, I am happy with the results and looks like a well invested development time. It is not completely done though. There are bits and pieces of old UI and workflow still there which will be flushed out by the follow up patches. My hope is to get it done completely by the month's end, but that's just my wishful thinking and could be few more patch cycles until you get to experience the "complete overhaul" that I intend - UI and workflow wise.

[h1]There are few things to note:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Only the first 3 levels were re-balanced as later features still need to be overhauled. I expect to complete it within the next few patch cycle. The rest of the levels may crash or be unbeatable at the moment.
[*] Things that were not broken may be broken now. Many codes were moved around, rewritten or replaced. Please be patient until all things are sorted out.
[*] Smooth movement for furniture placement in rooms were implemented but not for the furnitures not in the room. I did this intentionally so that players can compare and give feedback. I personally like the new smooth movement :D
[*] Some UI sounds are missing as I didn't have time to find or record them yet. I expect to complete it within the next few patch cycle.
[*] 32-bit support will soon end.
[*] If you have suggestions game play wise, make em now!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27160163/ee75731986b36607f5d7da293cddf459eb8f0f08.jpg[/img]
The above space will be used for showing guest/staff history, thoughts and other useful information for the player should he needs to diagnose a problem.

notes.title: DB010 delayed to 24th!
notes.content:
EDIT: Date was changed from 20th to 24th.
EDIT2: New staff training rooms will not be part of the patch. It will be included in the following patch.

So, evaluating where the Dev Build is at the moment, I have completed all that I planned for this patch. But, after several gameplay testing, I decided to delay the patch another week as there are few things that the game really needs. 

[h1]1. Remove the current relocation workflow completely.[/h1]
Until now, relocating (or moving furniture around after placing it) required clicking on the "relocation" button then selecting the furniture then clicking "relocate". When Tavern Tycoon was first designed, I had very little issues with this approach, but now that the game is working at its full capacity, this workflow is very tedius and unintuitive. Hence, I am moving to the "new workflow".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27160163/87131cd215eaf37a1377fdbcf23a6392a66e1e2b.jpg[/img]

Basically, players can now simply move the cursor over any furniture and it will be highlighted (until now, only staff members had this behavior). Clicking on it will prompt a small panel with buttons and information about the furniture. From here, you can either move, replace with new, call for repairs or sell it. 

This change was made quite late but it is currently fully functional and ready.

[h1]2. But the rooms still work like the old times[/h1]
After play testing for several hours, I realized how the new workflow for furnitures felt "right" and almost "perfect". But the rooms, which is still based on the old workflow, now felt "outdated" and sort of "hard" to work with. At this point I really had to re-evaluate and ask if the room workflow should be changed to the new workflow as well. And my conclusion was yes. I begun porting codes last night and so far, I like how it is going. It is not done yet, but should not give any unexpected surprises.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27160163/ad2782a8ddf95f057d3b759553f50efba4d2116e.jpg[/img]
Left is the old workflow with new UI, but I want to implement the new workflow on in as well.

[h1]3. New staff balance and training[/h1]
Staff in general has been changed in many ways. For example, staff members now have perks! Staff avatar and UI had a facelift as well. This part is done and fully functional. But, after playing testing, I realized that there needs to be a some sort of training room so that players can choose who gains what sort of perks and who levels up. Currently, staff members level up steadily over time and gain perks after each levelling up which eliminates the player's input in general. This made every staff after few years a master level staff at very low wage. This is broken in terms of gameplay and it needs to be redesigned. The goal is to give the choice to the players as the manager and decide who will be a long term staff and who is not.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27160163/8a143702a62877f069ecc903aee51b7b0377bd52.jpg[/img]

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
I think polishing the game and spending more time on balancing the gameplay have revealed areas of the game that needs to be reinforced. It is unfortunate that the patch has to be delayed, but the three things mentioned above is quite critical for the game to play as it was intended, so the delay was inevitable. 

My current goal is to polish the DB010 build and release it before the end of October and following it up with a pushdown to the Main Build early November.

notes.title: So, what exactly is happening in September?
notes.content:
In case you are not aware, I announced a few weeks ago that I will be spending the whole month of September to polish and mostly balance the game - something that Tavern Tycoon sorely needs at this point. 
I would like to use this opportunity to elaborate:

[h1]1. General Moneymaking: (60% Complete)[/h1]
There have been many reports that Tavern Tycoon, in its current state, is too hard and somewhat impossible to win. While I am not sure about it being "impossible," I do agree that it is hard to make money and consequently win the level. My angle with this problem is by generally increasing the profit margin. I will spare the details as it is not finalized and I will try to share as much as I can about this issue.

[h1]2. Staff Wage and Perks: (40% Complete)[/h1]
Staff in general is being rebalanced, and that means, skills, wage and the new perk system will play a vital role into your decision making. Some staff will move faster, some staff will get more tips, and some staff will heal faster and so on...

[h1]3. New UI: (70% Complete)[/h1]
I have also been working on the new UI, primarly focusing on the usability and the asthetics. Here is a WIP of staff hiring panel:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27160163/6bbbfdcf52abc9c3dca40d30ae91df6f15ac4c0a.png[/img]

Here is another WIP of selecting furnitures. Basically, you can now hover your mouse over any furniture, which will then show a white outline to show the selection. If you click on the furniture, it will display a small information panel above the furniture. In general, I am trying to move away from clicking "Relocate" and back and forth. Instead, an intuitive straight forward UI to do what you want to do.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27160163/36766b5fe177050066c79c20f788a02dd4d86e03.png[/img]

[h1]4. Transition Animation: (90% Complete)[/h1]
This is something I have been setting aside but I believe with the new UI, it was finally the right time to do so. Basically, I am adding smoothness to any transition of any in game transition. A good example would be opening up the zone panel or rotating furnitures before placement. Instead of instantly snapping, it will now transition smoothly, mostly with appropriate animations.

The general direction at the moment is to turn Tavern Tycoon into a Full release ready game now that all ten levels are out. I am not sure when that will happen, but it feels like the right time to begin polishing the game.

I expect most of the work to be public-release ready by the end of the month and hopefully be pushed down to the main build soon.

notes.title: Dev Build DB008.9 Released!
notes.content:
This patch adds a simple configuration wizard in preparation of pushing the current Dev Build to the Main Build. I will be focusing on finding bugs and polishing the current Dev Build until the projected date of mid July.

Please report bugs as usual!

[h1]Please note 1:[/h1]
 32-bit support will be deprecated soon.

[h1]Please note 2:[/h1]
In the past week, I've been releasing patches on daily basis. This is my effort to stabilize the Dev Build as soon as possible so that it can be pushed down to the Main Build (I expect it to happen mid July). The effort while good and all, may introduce new bugs as the daily patches are not going through a thorough QA process. It is ironic, but please understand and report bugs be it old or new and I will do my best to resolve them quickly.

[h1]Please note 3:[/h1]
At the moment, I have made the decision to exclude the invasion system from the game completely. It is 90% functional at this point and some of you might have seen it in action in DB008.7 (It was included as a mistake :D) but it is now completely removed. The reason being, as I've mentioned in my previous posts, is that it shifts the core gameplay experience in general and I feel as a developer that it is not what Tavern Tycoon is about.

Hope this helps!

Thank you!

notes.title: Dev Build DB008.1 Released!
notes.content:
After many delays and reconsiderations, DB008.1 finally arrives!

I am not doing a full release note here as pretty much every entry would require a lengthy description but to keep it simple and short:

[olist]
[*]Level 7 and Level 8 is now available.
[*]Trade system : Other taverns will offer trades. Expect player offering trades at a later stage.
[*]Storage system : Guests will now store baggage and collect them on their way out. Baggage effects movement speed and general satisfaction.
[/olist]

[h1]Please note that all the new features are experimental.[/h1]

I made an announce few days ago that I will be scrapping Invasion system entirely and consequently, the champion system. The issue here was that the introduction of the new system made the game feel very different - almost like a castle defender game.

Since then, I've been reshaping the whole invasion system to be more fitting to the game and adding extra layer of player choices and queues to smoothly fit with the current gameplay style.

For example, before an invasion, invaders will send you a letter, asking you for something. The player will be given 4 choices: Provoke, Reject, Stall or Accept. 

[list]
[*] If you choose "Accept" invader's demands, the invaders will not attack your tavern but you will lose reputation and of course, gold if that is what the invaders asked for.

[*]If you choose "Stall", depending on the invader and your reputation, they might give you some time.

[*]If you choose "Reject" or "Provoke" then invaders will either be straight out attacking your tavern or back off - depending on how strong your champion forces are. When the invasion actually occurs, then your champions will automatically fight the invaders, and will try to minimize damage done to the tavern.
[/list]

DB008.2 should have all these new features included, and we shall see from there :D.

So far, I am quite happy with the changes I made, and reminds me that I should be adding more depth to other aspects of the game.

If you choose "Reject" or "Provoke" then invaders will either be straight out attacking your tavern or back off - depending on how strong your champion forces are. When the invasion actually occurs, then your champions will automatically fight the invaders, and will try to minimize damage done to the tavern.

notes.title: Future of Tavern Tycoon
notes.content:
[h1]The New Invasion System[/h1]
So, I've completed the whole champion/invasion system last night and have spent the whole day looking at the game as a whole. To cut to the chase, I think the invasion system, which was planned to be featured during the later stages of the game (7 and upward) is a fresh new element. However, after completing and playing through it, I could not shake the feeling that the new system was changing the genre of the game - from a tycoon to something that felt more like a tower defence game.

I am aware that some of you have shown concerns about the invasion system previously, that it being too disruptive to the "peaceful nature" of the game. While I wasn't sure about those comments at the time, I am quite sure that while the new invasion system is fun, it does take away from the game significantly.

In light of this, I am scrapping the whole system. 

Level 7 and 8 will still arrive on May 20, the invasion system was only a portion of those two levels, and should I feel that the levels need more new features to keep it interesting, I shall do so at a later stage.

My current thoughts are that the invasion system could work for an endless/sandbox mode, by providing a regular challenge to the player to keep it interesting, so it still may appear in the game but just not on scenarios. Nevertheless, it is a tough pill to swallow after months of work put into it.

[h1]Preparing for the full release[/h1]
Tavern Tycoon was released in Feb 2017 and so far, it has been wonderful. But, I think it is time for me to seriously prepare the game for full release. Some of the details still need to be ironed out, but the current status of the game is like this.

level 1~6 is released
level 7 and 8 is about to be released
level 9 is almost complete
level 10 is still WIP.

Based on this, here are some key decisions I've made regarding full release.

[list]
    [*]The full scenario will consist of 10 missions instead of 11.
    [*]Level 10 will be released before the end of June.
    [*]During the month of July, I won't be adding new features but only bug fixes. Steam achievement will be added in full during this time as well.
    [*]Starting August, I shall be releasing Release Candidate Builds and will be working on localization of the game.
    [*]Release the full game in September.
[/list]

There are some undecided issues and questions that you want to ask, so here they are:

Q: What language will be supported? 
A: To be decided in August.

Q: Will it have endless/sandbox mode?
A: To be decided after the release of all 10 levels.

Q: Why 10 levels instead of 11?
A: I feel that contents of the game is there for 10 levels, and to cater for another level will feel like just stretching the game. The scrapping of the invasion system is partly to blame, but I would rather have 10 interesting levels rather than 11 mildly interesting ones. Level 6 feels like this at the moment and some features from level 7 will be pushed down to it. Consequently, level 7 will have features from 8 and so on. Hence the need for level 11 has naturally disappeared.

If you have any questions regarding the full release of Tavern Tycoon, please feel free to comment. But in general, my immediate focus is to polish the current game, and present a bug-free version of the game first. Then I shall work on having the game balanced so that the experience is not frustrating.

As for the scale of the game, it is not too difficult to expand further, but expanding further seems like an endless conquest and has to end at some point. I feel that by the end of the 10 levels, it should be where it was first designed to be.

This is it!

Thanks for reading and enjoy your day.

notes.title: Update on the New AI System.
notes.content:
Now that we are few days away from  April 1, I think I can put out few dates with more information. The new pathing system will debut this Sunday on Dev Build. It has its kinks here and there and I expect bugs to pop up here and there. Similar to our previous iteration, it will take few patches to stabilize it. 

I have introduced three new features to the new pathing system. And they are:

1) Room relocation will wait for the active guests in the room to leave.
2) Guests will roam near a point of interest instead of randomly dozing off.
3) Guests will immediately head to the point of interest.

So far, the 1 and 2 seems rock solid. But 3 seems a bit unstable in my opinion. I am sure as we straighten out bugs here and there it will get there, but just wanted to put it out there.

I am still positive about the new system as it has fixed many internal engine issues that I had implement workarounds to resolve them. Also, given its short development time, it is rather doing quite well :D Hopefully by the end of April, we will be free of AI issues!

Hope this helps!

EDIT: I changed Saturday to Sunday as it is a typo.

2) Guests will roam near a point of interest instead of randomly dozing off.
3) Guests will immediately head to the point of interest.

notes.title: Dev Build DB006 Released!
notes.content:
From the looks of it, DB006 seems very stable. I was able to play level 1 to level 5 without any issues (This took me around 20+ hours but hey!)

I will push DB006 as main build some time next week if no further bugs are found. Please report bugs for DB as much as you can this week (if possible). It would be a great help!

Here is what I have in mind:
[list]
    [*]Mid Jan: Push DB006 + @ as version 0.3 
    [*]Late Jan: Release DB007 with Level 6 and 7
    [*]Early Feb: Release DB008 with Level 8
    [*]Mid Feb: Iterate on DB009
    [*]Late Feb Push DB009 + @ as version 0.4
[/list]

The cycle between 0.3 and 0.4 is not that long as it was meant to be one to begin with, but I am feeling comfortable with this split so I just wanted to let everyone know. Obviously, this is not a promise, but my wishes.


Release Notes for DB006:

[h1]New Features and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Masters system (You can now contract a bard to stay and perform) (Experimental)
    [*]Furniture can be requested for repairs at any time.
    [*]Furniture can be replaced with new at any time.
    [*]Furniture status overlay icon.
    [*]New damage projection overlay
    [*]Improved radius overlay render speed and transition speed.
    [*]Furnitures destruction (furnitures get destroyed completely when maxHP is lower than 10)
    [*]New furniture grid overlay texture and style.
    [*]All panels show current gold.
    [*]Staff raise difference is deducted immediately.
[/list]

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed handyman glitching when a furniture is removed during repairs.
    [*]Fixed not able to move picked up staff around with zoomed in camera.
    [*]Fixed level 2 and 4 crashing at load.
    [*]Fixed piano not being fixed.
    [*]Fixed thought bubbles rendering on top of game UI.
    [*]Fixed research workshop being saved as admin's office.
    [*]Fixed firepit stop working after load.
    [*]Fixed stage and piano not sobering up drunk guests.
    [*]Fixed furniture repairing happening after purchasing a new furniture.
    [*]Fixed incorrect positioning of guest details UI
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Room building may fail when paused (cancel and retry)
    [*]Fighting (Brawling) is temporarily disabled.
    [*]Wait/Leave option is temporarily disabled.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Build DB005 Released!
notes.content:
So the long waited Dev build 005 is here! Unfortunately I had to cut out the new levels from this release as they were not ready, but hey, 005 build comes with many new features and fixes!

FYI, Level 6, 7 and 8 will be released with Dev Build 006 (ETA late January)

I will be working until 24th, so if any hot fixes are needed, it will be addressed. After that, I will be on a leave until January 10.

Happy Holiday Season!

Note: I will be opening up a new section of bug reports for the dev build. Please report bugs there.

[h1]New Features and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Annual reporting.
    [*]Property damage and repairs (job for handymen, can be repaired at 70% original capacity).
    [*]Earthquake.
    [*]Room overlay texture pattern.
    [*]Pause Feature.
    [*]Support for FXAA, SMAA and TXAA (deprecated MSAA)
    [*]Can cancel employment by right clicking before dropping new staff.
    [*]Deferred decals (Much faster and better looking).
    [*]Screen space contact shadows (improves shadow bias)
    [*]Annual reporting UI polished.
    [*]New Spa water graphics with bubble FX.
    [*]MSVO option added.
    [*]Additional messages and mails.
    [*]New camera zoom style.
    [*]Hardware accelerated mouse cursor.
    [*]Optimized guest rendering performance.
[/list]

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Drunk guests will not queue for any rooms. Instead, they will roam around drunk until sober.
    [*]Rat click sometimes not registering.
    [*]Relocating or deleting tables after dining leaves the dishes floating.
    [*]Guests spawning at the tavern gate instead of end of the entry way.
    [*]MSAA text overlay for in game options panel removed.
    [*]Removed news slider (Will not be added back, removed permanently)
    [*]Removed Infrastructure panel (Will be added back at a later stage)
    [*]Fixed bench selection panel bug.
    [*]Furnitures can be placed next to gates on Level 5.
    [*]Removed staff podium furniture.
    [*]Staff area settings and level not getting saved.
    [*]Fixed zoning overlay not turning off after cancelling during pause.
    [*]Fixed not being able to zoom in and out mid building rooms.
    [*]Changed zoning color shading style (faster and cleaner).
    [*]Improved room zoning performance.
    [*]Added incoming mail soundFX.
    [*]Mails not showing when paused.
    [*]Staff info panel accessible during relocation.
    [*]Time speed setting back to normal after closing in game menu.
    [*]Ability to control camera in game menu.
    [*]staff members picked up during pause not showing drop animation. 
    [*]Magazine subscription save file support.
    [*]Relocating chessboard when a guest is waiting for opponent causing duplicate seating.
    [*]Number of uses not reflecting for certain furnitures.
    [*]Smaller and faster game executable.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Room building may fail when paused (cancel and retry)
    [*]Fighting (Brawling) is temporarily disabled.
    [*]Wait/Leave option is temporarily disabled.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.23d Released!
notes.content:
Instead of 0.24a, I am dubbing this patch as 0.23d and will be staying in the 0.23 cycle until all the features of 0.24 are ready. Below is a short list of new features that I was able to wrap up for this release.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]World detail option (now fully functional)
    [*]Dynamic environment - level 4 only
    [*]Hardware acceleration for the cursor (lobby only)
    [*]Memory optimization
[/list]

There will be some changes and new features that you may notice - but will not be functional (eg. the new infrastructure panel or the news lines). They are temporarily disabled for now as they are not ready. I will unlock them as soon as they are.

Please note that all new features and addons are development build specific and will not be available on the default branch. When the development build reaches a stable point it will be pushed down.

[h1]The Upcoming 0.3 Cycle[/h1]
As I've showcased in my previous post, I am working on 7 new zones and 3 new stages for the 0.3 cycle: 

Storage, Brewery, Distillery, Ice Room, Boiler Room, VIP Suite, and Blacksmith.

I've also started working on the sandbox mode. It is in its early stages, but once the 0.3 cycle is released, I should be able to devote more time towards it.

That's all!

notes.title: Build 0.23a Released!
notes.content:
Build 0.23a arrives with the new camera and graphics! 

Please note that if you are experiencing graphical glitches of any sort, please report them via forum :D

Also, most people should experience performance boost, provided that your system meets the minimum hardware requirements. But, if you are running an ancient system, performance will drop or even not run at all. I am just putting this word out because I know that some people (very few but some) are running the game with lower specs than the minimum requirements. Anything with quad core processor, 4G+ RAM, and a gaming GPU manufactured in the last 5 years should be good. I have a test bench with AMD HD7850 from 2012 that runs this game without any issues at 60FPS.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New Camera perspective
    [*]Graphical revision of all five levels
    [*]Deprecated MSAA for TAA, HDR and motion blur support
    [*]Change in rendering path (forward -> deferred) which will improve lighting performance
    [*]New decal system (Improves visuals and render performance)
    [*]Level specfic lighting and sun simulation (underground levels don't experience time of the day)
    [*]Improved Screen projection algorythm (better staff drag and zone building)
    [*]Supersampling (render scale in options) is no longer supported and removed.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Staff area settings not saved (for compatibility reasons)
    [*]Fighting (Brawling) is temporarily disabled.
    [*]Magazine subscription save file support (for compatibility reasons)
[/list]

notes.content:
Build 0.23a arrives with the new camera and graphics! 

Please note that if you are experiencing graphical glitches of any sort, please report them via forum :D

Also, most people should experience performance boost, provided that your system meets the minimum hardware requirements. But, if you are running an ancient system, performance will drop or even not run at all. I am just putting this word out because I know that some people (very few but some) are running the game with lower specs than the minimum requirements. Anything with quad core processor, 4G+ RAM, and a gaming GPU manufactured in the last 5 years should be good. I have a test bench with AMD HD7850 from 2012 that runs this game without any issues at 60FPS.

    [*]Graphical revision of all five levels

    [*]New decal system (Improves visuals and render performance)

notes.title: Build 0.2g Released!
notes.content:
Build 0.2g is here! I've tried to hunt down as many hidden bugs as I can, including the level 3 crashing bug. Please start a new game (not from level 1 but the level that you are trying to play) and also please update your drivers as well. I've had outdated drivers causing crashes, not many, but definitely a few.

Also, if you are experiencing severe pixelation of your screen, to the point of unplayable screen, that means you are using a pirated copy - it is one of anti piracy tricks I put in, but totally forgot about it since nobody came to me with that "bug" haha. So, if you are experiencing this "bug" then, well, I can't help you :D

I am working on 0.2h now, and 0.21a to be released by the month's end. It should wrap up the 0.2 build to a stable build. The sooner this happens, the quicker I can get on for level 6.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]All staff members sitting on one couch.
[*]Clicking on kids sometimes crashing the game.
[*]Spa fee capped at 20 Gold.
[*]Restroom and gambling den fees not getting charged.
[*]Maidens research even when they are tired when manually dropped in the room.
[*]Bartender getting stuck at bar.
[*]Knights not paying fees after using exercise mats.
[*]Door relocation post-building not working.
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bartenders can research (Improves quality of mead which influences sobering up speed)
[*]Dirt particles are pooled (slightly larger memory foot print, but helps performance)
[*]Monthly report mails merge (Prevents mail clutter)
[*]Improved NPC path correction if disturbed mid transition
[*]Added staff level up features
[*]Adjusted Scam & Spam cycle (less spamming)
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fighting (Brawling) is temporarily disabled. Should makes its ways back via 0.21a (few days away)
[*]The new mead research levels will not be saved, hence will be lost after a load game, this is to provide save file compatibility. It is not a bug, but a temporary design choice for an experimental feature. It will be saved coming 0.21a patch.
[*]New NPC Pathfinding is in works but I have improved the current pathfinding logic to be equal or even better than pre 0.2 builds. Once the new pathfinding is done, it will make its way to public builds.
[/list]
Ps. Please post bugs at the bug report forum. It really makes my tracking and feedback difficult if posted here as a reply. Thanks!

notes.content:
So here it is! Build 0.2 is here! 

Okay, now let's down to business. As many of you guys know, I spent two months and two delays to get this build ready. I did this because I wanted a clean build that was bug-free. Unfortunately, that dream did not come true. I am quite sure that there will be bugs, just waiting to be found.

Nevertheless, I am releasing this build because delaying any further wasn't helping in any way - also, some new players were getting a bit anxious after this long gap in patches. I will be releasing hot fixes similar to what we did during the first week of release. So expect bugs all around. Hopefully by this time next week, 0.2 will be what we all hoped to be. 

It really is a shame that 0.2 is releasing prematurly after all the work put into it but it should be ironed out in a week's time. Build should be going live at 10PM PT.

notes.title: 0.2 Build and News! (Update)
notes.content:
UPDATE: [i]I am pushing the update back to Wednesday - the QA results were not not the best...XD I will have to investigate a bit more :D I will keep everyone updated as usual as fast as I can. Thanks! [/i]

I am making this announce to let everyone know that 0.2 is expected to arrive between Sat~Sun this week. And just like any other time, this date is tentative. From the looks of it, I am quite confident about the current status, so unless new things pop up unexpectedly, I think it is safe to confirm the date. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27160163/64137aee9c42b6b06f93257ba0be53aadc6242c5.jpg[/img]
This is one of the new guests - rogue/hunter

Level 5 will be about running the tavern at an old abandoned underground dungeon and we will be moving away from Lord Peter (hahahaha) to some new authority :D


[h1]Restroom Issue[/h1]
I am noticing that restroom queue issue is still cropping up but it turns out that some people were using the old save file which made me hunt for issues that did not exist (version compatibility is not supported). I've lost a day trying to figure this out...but hey welcome to game development :D

Regardless, I am going to run another pass of tests to make sure.


[h1]Start-up Issue[/h1]
I've had numerous reports of the game getting stuck at launch after an update. It's happening - I am not 100% sure yet - due to the game failing to read/write configuration data. This is easily resolved by deleting all .dat files inside the game directory. The new upcoming 0.2 build has a built in cleaner to remove non-compatible or failed read/write .dat files to prevent this so this shouldn't be an issue after the update. 


[h1]Leave a review[/h1]
This is kind of corny....but please leave a Steam review if you can spare a few minutes :D it helps the developement process as well.

Just don't be a troll :D :D :D

notes.title: Patch 8 Released!
notes.content:
Finally, Patch 8 is here! 

Before we go any further, I am letting everyone know that a large portion of this build was rewritten. Honestly, I expect new bugs and glitches. I've only had 2 days to QA this build - if you've been following the patch notes lately, you would know this XD

I will be releasing the 9th patch around Tuesday/Wednesday to remedy newly found bugs along with the improved management features. Please let me know ASAP if you see a bug via the bug report forum.

Also, I am no longer going to use the term "hot fix" as we are almost a month into release - seems it is not hot enough XD

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New NPC queue system.
    [*]Improved memory usage.
    [*]Resolution check prompt.
    [*]Improved furniture usage information.
    [*]Improved NPC info detection during mouse over events
[/list]

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]NPCs getting stuck in "Thinking about what to do" state.
    [*]Level 4 hiring market was too harsh (no one for hire for months)
    [*]Benches.
    [*]Not able to load auto save file via in-game menu.
    [*]Furniture relocation  
    [*]Maidens not researching at times.
    [*]Picking up maidens mid serving randomly causing NPC behavior issues.
    [*]Dust FX not turning off when a handyman is picked up mid sweeping.
    [*]Furniture relocation panel ui showing empty list.
    [*]Raise request mail not showing correct NPC.
    [*]Handyman's broom stays on screen after it is destroyed.
    [*]Reception desk doesn't collide with other reception desks.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
 [*]Guests will wait by default if a room/furniture that they want is missing. Option to choose their action will be added in Patch 9.
 [*]Fighting is disabled temporarily - will be added back in Patch 9.
    [*]Some NPCs will be stuck trying to get to some place (moving around a small spot). It doesn't break the game and it is fixed upon save/load so this was sidelined for this patch. It will be handled soon.
[/list]

Peace!

[i]ps. Please post bug report at the forum and not here as a reply. It makes tracking bugs really hard when information is not centralized. Thanks![/i]

    [*]FXAA not getting applied in game.
    [*]Level 4 instability and AI failing.

    [*]Last staff on the staff hire list causing unexpected results.

    [*]Reception desk placed next to rooms preventing room furniture placement

notes.title: 5th Hot Fix Patch Released.
notes.content:
[b]Quick Announcement before patch notes!
[h1]Please do not use virtual resolution scaling like nVidia DSR on Tavern Tycoon. [/h1]
It will result in launcher getting stuck in a loop showing splash screen. Tavern Tycoon will soon support super sampling AA anyway, so please do not use it. It is not supported. If you get stuck in the loop anyway, just kill the game with Alt+F4 and follow the guide in the Troubleshooting section.
http://steamcommunity.com/app/439340/discussions/2/135507855751608705/
[/b]






A quick small hot fix to address one issue - 3rd level path finding. 6th patch is in works and should be released soon. 

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Game client will perform game data validation before launch.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]3rd level outdoor pathfinding error.
    [*]Arcane Study doors play the wooden door sound instead of the magic door sound.
[/list]


[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Door relocation is just a place holder for the next update. It is not implemented yet. 
    [*]Some NPCs will be stuck trying to get to some place (moving around a small spot). It doesn't break the game and it is fixed upon save/load so this was sidelined for this patch. It will be handled soon.
[/list]


ps. Please do not post bugs here on this announcement. Please use the Bug Report Forum, where most of the involved community members are.

Enjoy.

notes.title: 4th Hot Fix Patch Released!
notes.content:
So, after the horrible night of bugs...(Yes that's what I am calling it) I am releasing this 4th hot fix patch. In the given amount of time, I was able to do quite a bit of work, but since this is the first week of release, I've not had enough time to test the patch itself inside out. I will be on my toes to fix anything on the fly so please use the bug reporting section.

I've also tried to incorporate as many suggestions as I humanly can. Some suggestions and improvements are still in works so please be patient if a feature did not make this release (eg. camera rotation)

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Refund system (Experimental)
    [*]End of researchable recipes no longer show "failed to research" message.
    [*]Improved research notification mail.
    [*]Zoom level increased by 5%.
    [*]Added mouse scroll support for the management panel.
    [*]Pressing "Home" key moves the camera to the center of town.
    [*]Menu sound retouched (slightly)
[/list]

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Relocation in general.
    [*]Staff asking for raise after getting fired.
    [*]Staff pick up issues in general.
    [*]Guest room queue getting stuck.
    [*]Bartender gets stuck
    [*]NPCs getting stuck in restroom.
    [*]Group reservation mail saying "4" instead of "wizard".
    [*]NPC moves to closed areas.
    [*]Bartender stays put after getting fired.
    [*]Mail titles sliding faster when game speed is faster.
    [*]Mail getting stuck on the view page.
    [*]Fixed staff panel window closing the panel when clicked.

notes.title: 3rd Hot Fix Arrives!
notes.content:
Its been 3 days since release, and here comes the 3rd hot fix patch. This will probably be the last "Hot Fix" patch for the moment as I'd like to focus on the relocation problem starting today. I don't expect it to take too long so no big worries :D

BTW, if something is claimed to be fixed but not, please let me know.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Level clear mail can no longer be deleted from the mailbox.
    [*]Minimum room parameters shown on room list.
    [*]Bartender will leave bar and update his status if he is too tired instead of just standing at the bar(some people thought the bartender was getting stuck)
    [*]Management panel now supports scrolling.
    [*]Management panel now shows staff potential
[/list]

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Dirt/blood/vomit is randomly not cleaned by handymen.
    [*]Two handymen trying to clean one dirt. 
    [*]Sometimes level clear scroll wouldn't arrive even when all requirements are met.
    [*]Loaded game showing zero tavern value until something is purchased.
    [*]In-game menu displaying previous panels after exiting with ESC key
    [*]Save file compatibility warning UI offset corrected.
    [*]Save file warning text offset corrected.
    [*]Level clear mail was not getting loaded after a save
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Relocation that involves kitchen, table and maiden breaks the game.
[/list]

Please report bugs and suggestions on the discussion forum and not here. I am flooded with information atm, so please centralize them for me. Thanks!

notes.title: 2nd Hot Fix Arrives!
notes.content:
[code]Before we go any further, please note that most features visible are already implemented and is well. These are: research workshop, spa, study etc...there are things that are not functioning as I planned (eg. relocation...relocation...relocation) but everything else is good :D ....if something is not happening...its probably because its either too early (eg. nobody in level 1 is going spa) or you are doing something wrong XD  I just wanted clarify this :D[/code]

Here comes the 2nd patch. This should greatly improve the game so hop on! I am trying my best to stabilize the game within a week of release (so I still have 4~5 days). Of course, fixing relocation is now my number one priority :D

BTW, if something is claimed to be fixed but not, please let me know.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Tutorial is only enabled for New Game, and not for Stage Select.
    [*]Added in level objective menu for revising objectives mid game.
    [*]Zoom in and out with Q and E key (experimental).
[/list]

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Some UI elements active before loading ends.
    [*]Load game failing to begin.
    [*]In game load menu failing to load.
    [*]Level winning scroll can get stuck if other panels are on.
    [*]Sound volume option not working.
    [*]Staff member getting picked up during other UI interaction.
    [*]Staff members geting stuck in air if both left and right mouse button pressed.
    [*]Attempting name change mid tutorial makes the whole UI inactive.
    [*]Loaded games with empty tavern name display empty signboard instead of " - - - ".
    [*]Level jukebox plays same tracks for all levels.
[/list]

These are reported issues that I could not replicate, hence couldn't fix. Please let me know if anyone knows more about these issues.

[h1]Suspected Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Group reservations in the first two levels result in higher visitors than requested (eg.6 instead of 3 or 20 instead of 10).
    [*]Double clicking the hire button results in staff members half buried in the ground.
    [*]Two mails get stuck in the mail box.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Relocation that involves kitchen, table and maiden breaks the game.
[/list]

notes.title: First Build Released!
notes.content:
So the long awaited Tavern Tycoon arrived via Early Access. As promised, it features 4 first levels of the game (the final version will feature 11 levels)

Some of the following issues were discovered too late into release, they will be patched soon.
[list]
    [*]Relocating some furnitures can bug the game (especially the kitchen and table) Please save and reload to prevent this from causing your session to be unplayable.
    [*]Music tracks from the first level repeats for the later levels. This will be fixed through a hot fix within 24 hours.
    [*]And some Early Access bugs that I haven't discovered :D
[/list]

Lastly, many thanks to everyone who supported the development. Let's make this game better together!

EDIT: current build supports 64 bit Windows only. 32-bit versions will be added next week.

Peace!
